chapters.blurb: Nine generations, on one street in Campania: the Falco of Arienzo, and the one branch that reached Brisbane.

chapters.title: About
chapters.blurb: An evidence-first archive of one family's maternal line, Arienzo in the province of Caserta to Brisbane. Every claim carries its confidence or is marked unproven.

chapters.title: Method
chapters.blurb: Every one of these family archives grades a claim with the same five words, so a level means the same thing wherever you meet it.

parts.title: A valley under the hills near Naples
parts.intro: Arienzo is a comune of some six thousand people in the province of Caserta, at the western mouth of the Valle Caudina, and for at least two centuries it was the whole world of this family: nine generations inside one valley under the hills near Naples, four of them on strada Camellara. Falco is the Latin and Italian for falcon, a surname coined independently in many places, so the place and the street come first and the name after them.

parts.title: Nine generations on one street
parts.intro: Nine documented generations in one valley, 1767 to now, each joined to the one above it by a record that names a father, except the first, where the line stops. Every generation of the line is half somebody else's family, so each family married in has its own page beside the line itself.

parts.title: From Arienzo to Brisbane
parts.intro: Seven generations never left Arienzo. Then, inside a single lifetime, the line moved four times and crossed the world: five moves in all, four of which you could walk in a day and one which you could not. The Australian half of the archive was built out of a cemetery index, and it answered a question the registers could not.

parts.title: How the lines join
parts.intro: A family history that follows only one surname is half a history, and a shared surname in one small town is suggestive and nothing more. These pages follow the marriages, the blood relatives and the DNA that join the lines, the families the collaterals married, and the households that no record joins to the line.
